system.description:
Veterans of the Wall facing the Red Waste — disciplined, grim, no pageantry.

  • Wall-Forged Dread: your Demoralise replaces the usual one.
  • Once per day, enemies suffer −6 to Charisma checks and must make a Will save against your Class Save DC or have Disadvantage on all their attack rolls.
  • It lasts rounds equal to your Knight level and affects up to 25 creatures at 5th, 100 at 7th, 250 at 9th, 1,000 at 12th and 5,000 at 16th.
  • It cannot combine with Inspire or Embolden.
  • Siege Discipline: Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment, or coordinating soldiers during a defensive action.
